fact: On Thursday 19 June 2025 the Direction Générale de la Sûreté Nationale held an awareness day to launch a programme to digitise the work of police commissariats, documenting activity on suspects, witnesses, victims, vehicles, stolen arms, reports and complaints; the police said deployment of the programme, supervised by the Office central de collecte des informations de police at the Direction de la police judiciaire, had reached 90% in the commissariats of Nouakchott.
title: Lancement d’un programme pour la numérisation du travail des commissariats de police
